title: Just average really in my eyes
text:
Just average really in my eyes. This is a decent multi purpose cleaner. It definitely has a scent to it that is not pleasant, they could have added something to cover it up a bit but oh well. It is a cleaner so I am not really complaining about that, you can pretty much expect that. The smell dissipates fairly quickly, faster than bleach so that is good. It is decent in getting rid of stains which is nice.

Hydrogen peroxide has been known to be a good disinfectant so that works well with this one.

It works well on a mirror and does not streak which is great. I had mediocre success in the shower with water stains there, so not the greatest with calcium stains. You need something more like CLR to really handle that I think. But hydrogen peroxide isn't really known to be the best when it comes to those kinds of stains really.

All in all not a bad all purpose cleaner but also not the most impressive either. This one to me is just middle of the road. Considering 2 bottles are about $19, I don't think this is a particularly great bargain or anything.
